name: @automagik/unfold-events-dsh
description: What Unfold's agent is doing, inside DSH: a right-sidebar tab with every event the agent sends, named in plain words and newest first, and Unfold's presence tab. It only watches: it attaches to the agent as a read-only observer through the address Unfold publishes for its own instance, and opens no port

description.en: See what Unfold's agent is doing, inside the Unfold instance's DSH. Adds two right-sidebar tabs: Unfold events, every event the agent sends in plain words, newest first; and Unfold, its presence, which says what it is doing right now. It only watches: it attaches to the agent read-only, through the address Unfold publishes for its own instance, and opens no port. Outside an Unfold instance it has nothing to show. Part of Unfold; works with the Unfold app.
